data.summary: Critical SQL injection plus resource leak and silenced errors. 5 issue(s) found. Most severe: SQL injection (critical).

output.summary: Critical SQL injection plus resource leak and silenced errors.

issues.title: SQL injection
issues.detail: user_id and statuses are interpolated into SQL. Use ? placeholders.

issues.title: Connection never closed
issues.detail: sqlite3.connect without close/context manager leaks a handle per call.

issues.title: Bare except hides failures
issues.detail: Any error (missing table, locked DB) is reported as 'no orders'.

issues.title: Mutable default argument
issues.detail: statuses=[] is shared between calls; use None or a tuple.

issues.title: Money summed as floats
issues.detail: Use integer cents or Decimal for monetary totals.

recommendations: Parameterise the query, including a generated IN (?, ?, ...) list.
Use `with closing(sqlite3.connect(...))` and let database errors propagate.
Compute the total in SQL (SUM(total)) or with Decimal.

cases.name: test_injection_payload_is_not_executed
cases.description: Injection payload must not match rows

traces.trace: user_id="x' OR '1'='1" -> query becomes WHERE user_id = 'x' OR '1'='1' -> condition always true
missing.db -> connect() creates an empty file -> execute() raises OperationalError (no such table) -> bare except sets rows=[]

issues: The function opens its own connection: tests need a real file database (no injection of a connection).
Errors are swallowed, so failure modes cannot be asserted.
test_injection_payload_is_not_executed: expected no rows, but returns all 3 orders
test_database_error_is_not_silenced: expected raises sqlite3.Error, but returns {'orders': [], 'total': 0}, no exception

data.summary: CHANGES REQUESTED — quality 3.5/10 (correctness 3, edge cases 3, robustness 2, readability 6). Changes requested: not production-ready (1 critical, 2 high).

output.summary: Changes requested: not production-ready (1 critical, 2 high).
findings: Both reviews independently flag the error swallowing (Analyzer: bare except; Tester: unassertable failures).
SQL injection is confirmed by a concrete failing test case.
Design couples connection management, querying and aggregation.
required_changes: Use parameterised queries for user_id and statuses (blocking).
Close the connection with a context manager (blocking).
Remove the bare except; let sqlite3.Error propagate or wrap it explicitly.
Accept a connection (or repository) parameter so the function can be unit-tested.
